article.en: I have just moved to a house in Bridge Street.
article.zh: 我刚刚搬进了大桥街的一所房子。

article.en: Yesterday a beggar knocked at my door.
article.zh: 昨天，一个乞丐来敲我的门。

article.en: He asked me for a meal and a glass of beer.
article.zh: 他向我要一顿饭和一杯啤酒。

article.en: In return for this, the beggar stood on his head and sang songs.
article.zh: 作为回报，那乞丐头顶地倒立起来，嘴里还唱着歌。

article.en: He ate the food and drank the beer.
article.zh: 他把食物吃完，又喝了酒。

article.en: Then he put a piece of cheese in his pocket and went away.
article.zh: 然后他把一块奶酪装进衣袋里走了。

article.en: Later a neighbour told me about him.
article.zh: 后来，一位邻居告诉了我他的情况。
他的名字叫珀西·巴顿斯。

article.en: He calls at every house in the street once a month and always asks for a meal and a glass of beer.
article.zh: 他每月对这条街上的每户人家光顾一次，总是请求给他一顿饭和一杯啤酒。
